# Bundled Cursor skills snapshot

This directory is a checked-in release input generated by `pnpm sync:cursor-skills` from the
commit recorded in `SOURCE.json`. Normal installs and builds do not access the network.

Each plugin retains its upstream manifest and license. The snapshot contains those files, each
skill's `SKILL.md`, and the files under a skill's directory that its text names (followed through
the files it pulls in). A script that belongs to a JS/TS project inside the skill is left out, since
one file of a project cannot run on its own. `SOURCE.json` records a deterministic SHA-256 digest of
the payload and every reference that is still missing, which the build re-checks.
Do not edit generated files by hand.
